about: Prompt building blocks for character images that look great on Persona and work with Shop the look. Replace {identity} with the same sentence every time.

identity_sentence.how_to: Write one sentence that describes the face, hair and signature detail. Paste it, word for word, into every prompt. This is the biggest secret to a consistent character.
identity_sentence.example: a woman in her mid 20s with a jet-black blunt bob with short fringe, warm olive skin, a small beauty mark under her left eye and a chrome star ear cuff

shots.name: Outfit hero
shots.why: Full outfit visible, so Shop the look can match every piece.
shots.prompt: Full-body photo of {identity}, wearing {outfit}, standing in {place}, natural light, 35mm photo, portrait orientation

shots.name: Portrait
shots.prompt: Close portrait of {identity}, {top}, soft window light, plain background, editorial beauty photo

shots.name: Street style
shots.why: Feels like a real moment, great on the homepage.
shots.prompt: Candid street-style photo of {identity} walking in {city}, wearing {outfit}, shot from across the street, shallow depth of field, portrait orientation

shots.name: At home
shots.why: Shows personality and the world around the character.
shots.prompt: {identity} at home {doing a hobby}, wearing {outfit}, warm lamp light, full outfit visible, lifestyle photo

shots.name: Mirror selfie
shots.why: Natural way to show a full look.
shots.prompt: Mirror selfie of {identity} in a minimal apartment, phone covering part of the face, wearing {outfit}, full length, soft daylight

shots.name: Detail
shots.why: Close-up on a bag, shoes or jewellery that people want to buy.
shots.prompt: Close-up detail photo of {identity}'s {item}, {outfit colour} outfit in soft focus behind, magazine product photo

settings.midjourney: --ar 2:3 --style raw, reuse the same --cref image of your character
settings.other_tools: Portrait 2:3 or 4:5, at least 1200 px on the long side
